description: Threads for 'The Meridian Spine' (Book 2), detailing the progression and resolution of key narrative arcs, character developments, and conspiracy layers.

threads.name: The Meridian Spine Fraud & National Capture
threads.book1_resolution: Stellan Marsh is exposed on chapter 19-20 as the architect of the National Integrity Directorate, which he built as a capture instrument to launder national procurement. The physical tool-mark proof is published on chapter 21, leading to his arrest. Iris resigns from the Directorate on chapter 22, choosing the record over the office.
threads.book2_promise: The redacted page named a foreign counter-signatory, and the tool-mark appears on a contract outside Iris's jurisdiction, indicating the conspiracy extends internationally for Book 3.
